authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Planning Data describes Local plan boundary as the area a local plan covers and currently reports 364 local-plan boundaries. The specification requires a permanent boundary reference and Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry, and can bind boundaries to responsible organisations. A bounded window of at most 50 records was considered for the unresolved criterion. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative local-plan-boundary reference/name, local-plan reference/name, LPA/LAD/statistical-geography reference/name, organisation code, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any one of the 364 boundaries would therefore be an unsupported guess. No coverage_area_id is selected, no coverage Polygon/MultiPolygon is emitted, no source-area record is accepted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
